title: Prom and Yearbook
author: Quentin Galloway
blurb: Petra Coldharbour, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
